content.text:
=== docker-compose server svc ===
  server:
    build:
      context: ./server
      args:
        GIT_COMMIT: ${GIT_COMMIT:-unknown}
        BUILD_TIME: ${BUILD_TIME:-unknown}
        RELEASE_VERSION: ${RELEASE_VERSION:-unknown}
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      # media-gateway-migration (AC6): the server now serves /_matrix/media/v3/* directly
      # (Elixir Nebu.Media), so it needs MinIO healthy and the bucket/IAM-user
      # created — exactly the dependencies the removed `media:` service had.
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
      createbuckets:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    # media-gateway-migration (AC6): MinIO IAM credentials (file-based Docker
    # Secrets) consumed by Nebu.Media.Storage / config/runtime.exs ExAws config.
    secrets:
      - internal_secret
      - minio_app_access_key
      - minio_app_secret_key
    environment:
      # Story 5.29a — AC3: the server also uses nebu_app at runtime (no DDL from the server)
      NEBU_DB_URL: "postgresql://nebu_app:nebu_app_dev_pw@postgres:5432/nebu"
      DATABASE_URL: "ecto://nebu_app:nebu_app_dev_pw@postgres:5432/nebu"
      # go-removal-cleanup: migrations run as nebu_migrate (table owner) — ported from
      # the removed gateway service. server/Dockerfile invokes Nebu.Release.migrate/0 on
      # startup before the server boots, using this connection.
      NEBU_DB_URL_MIGRATE: "postgresql://nebu_migrate:nebu_migrate_dev_pw@postgres:5432/nebu"
      NEBU_INTERNAL_SECRET_FILE: "/run/secrets/internal_secret"
      NEBU_SERVER_NAME: "localhost"
      NEBU_PII_ENCRYPTION_KEY: "${NEBU_PII_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-6465766b65793030303030303030303030303030303030303030303030303030}"
      # oidc-bootstrap-only-config (ADR-022): OIDC is configured EXCLUSIVELY through the
      # Bootstrap Wizard (server_config) — there are NO NEBU_OIDC_* / NEBU_ADMIN_OIDC_*
      # config variables. A single OIDC client (dev Dex `nebu-gateway`, secret
      # `nebu-dev-secret`, all redirect URIs registered in dev/dex/config.yaml) serves
      # both Matrix Bearer validation and admin operator login. On a fresh DB the server
      # boots fail-closed (all Bearer tokens 401, admin → /bootstrap); run the wizard
      # once (issuer http://dex:5556/dex, client nebu-gateway / nebu-dev-secret, audience
      # nebu-gateway, JWKS http://dex:5556/dex/keys) to configure it.
      #
      # NEBU_OIDC_JWKS_TTL is the JwksCache refresh interval (a cache-tuning knob, NOT
      # OIDC issuer/audience/client config) and may stay.
      NEBU_OIDC_JWKS_TTL: "300"
      # DEV-ONLY: this stack serves the admin UI over plain http://localhost, so the
      # admin session cookie must NOT be Secure (otherwise the login-state cookie is
      # not returned on the OIDC callback in stricter browsers → "Invalid login state").
      # Production serves over TLS and leaves this unset (defaults to secure:true).
      NEBU_ADMIN_SESSION_SECURE: "false"
      # Integration-test escape hatch: set NEBU_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED=true in the host
      # environment before `docker compose up` to disable the IP rate limiter.
      # make test-integration sets this automatically; never set in production.
      NEBU_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED: "${NEBU_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED:-false}"
      # e2e-session-refresh-suites: Nebu session ceilings (default 8h, set in
      # Nebu.Web.SessionConfig). Leave empty for normal dev/prod (→ 8h). The
      # `make test-e2e-refresh` target sets these short on the host so the silent
      # OIDC-refresh loop fires within the test window. Empty / junk → 8h default
      # (parsed by SessionConfig.parse_ttl/1, never crashes the login path).
      NEBU_MATRIX_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS: "${NEBU_MATRIX_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS:-}"
      NEBU_ADMIN_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS: "${NEBU_ADMIN_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS:-}"
      # media-gateway-migration (AC6): media object storage, ported from the Go
      # `media:` service. Same MinIO bucket + nebu-app IAM credentials.
      NEBU_MINIO_ENDPOINT: "minio:9000"
      NEBU_MINIO_ACCESS_KEY_FILE: "/run/secrets/minio_app_access_key"
      NEBU_MINIO_SECRET_KEY_FILE: "/run/secrets/minio_app_secret_key"
      NEBU_MINIO_BUCKET: "nebu-media"
      NEBU_MINIO_USE_SSL: "false"
      # media-security-admin-control/3-clamav-genserver: ClamAV scanner client.
      # Nebu.Media.ClamAV tolerates clamd being unreachable at boot (AC7) — no
      # depends_on/healthy-gate is required here, clamd may come up after the
      # server (freshclam's first signature download can take a while).
      NEBU_CLAMAV_HOST: "clamav"
      NEBU_CLAMAV_PORT: "3310"
    ports:
      # go-removal-cleanup: the server now serves the public Matrix endpoint (host 8008)
      # and the admin UI (host 8080) — both formerly published by the Go gateway —
      # plus its own 4000. All three map to the single Bandit listener on server:4000.
      # (The gRPC network listener was removed — ADR-021; the server no longer opens port 9000.)

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== docker-compose server svc ==="; sed -n '/^  server:/,/^  [a-z]/p' docker-compose.yml | head -80
